decisions.reason: Reducing the displayed size of author attribution does not change the requirement to remediate article image quality when necessary.
The source changes the size of the independently represented author attribution, not the magazine-wide polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The author attribution size adjustment does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The author attribution size adjustment does not alter the deferred print-ready output format, resolution, or trim-and-bleed requirements.
Changing author attribution display size does not change where magazine articles must be sourced.

Although the adjustment affects an element within the layout, it does not change the candidate's template, supplied-input, compilation, or Flat Plan arrangement requirements; the specific display-size change is already owned by the author attribution Requirement.
